title: IRCON Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 54 Apprentices Posts
description: Indian Railway Construction International Limited (IRCON) has released the official notification for 2026. To fill 54 vacancies for Apprentices Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, Diploma in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, LLB, or any degree can grab this chance and apply for these posts. Here we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the IRCON Recruitment 2026 . Interested candidate...
